name: Grade 9 IIT Practice: August Week 8 - Data Product
description: Practice words for Grade 9 second-trimester Python and data work.

words.definition: A careful idea based on evidence.
words.example: The group made an inference that students preferred visual study guides.

words.definition: Advice about what should be done.
words.example: The recommendation suggested adding more practice charts to the lesson.

words.definition: A display that summarizes important data.
words.example: The dashboard displayed the main chart, total responses, and key finding.

words.definition: A visual product that explains information.
words.example: The infographic summarized the survey result with icons and one chart.

words.definition: An early version used for testing.
words.example: The prototype showed the first layout of the data product.

words.definition: Something that makes results less complete or certain.
words.example: The student listed a limitation because only one class answered the survey.

words.definition: Information that shows what happened or supports an idea.
words.example: The chart was evidence for the group's recommendation.
